settings.description: Use `enableArtifact` instead to turn off the Artifact tool, which publishes session output as a private web page on claude.ai.
settings.default: unset, so the tool follows your account's availability

settings.description: Stop Claude Code from registering the `claude-cli://` protocol handler with the operating system, which it otherwise does after you send the first prompt of an interactive session.
settings.default: unset, so Claude Code registers the handler

settings.description: Turn off Remote Control: Claude Code then refuses `claude remote-control`, the `--remote-control` flag, auto-start, and the in-session toggle, and reports that your organization's policy disabled it.
Turn off the Artifact tool, which publishes session output as a private web page on claude.ai.
settings.default: unset, so the tool follows your account's availability

settings.description: Get a push notification on your phone when a permission prompt or question is waiting for your input.
Choose how Claude Code notifies you when a task completes or a permission prompt is waiting.
Pick the default cloud environment for cloud sessions you create from the CLI, such as with `claude --cloud`.
settings.typeText: string, an environment ID such as `env_...` or `ccpool_...`
settings.default: unset, so Claude Code uses the Anthropic-hosted environment when your list has one, and otherwise the first environment in your list that isn't a Remote Control bridge environment, or the first environment when every one is a bridge environment

settings.description: Connect Remote Control automatically when each interactive session starts, instead of waiting for `/remote-control`.
settings.default: unset, so the auto-connect default applies

settings.description: Add SSH connections to the Desktop environment selector.
settings.typeText: array of objects, each with required `id`, `name`, and `sshHost` and optional `sshPort` and `sshIdentityFile`

settings.description: Add SSH connections whose host comes from a command to the Desktop environment selector.
settings.typeText: array of objects, each with required `id`, `name`, and `command` and optional `sshIdentityFile` and `startDirectory`. Desktop starts `command` without a shell, so write it as a program and plain arguments.

settings.description: Run your own command to produce the credential Claude Code sends with model requests.
settings.default: unset, so Claude Code doesn't run a helper

settings.description: Run your own command, such as `aws sso login`, to refresh the credentials in your `.aws` directory when the ones Claude Code has for Amazon Bedrock stop working.
settings.default: unset, so Claude Code doesn't refresh AWS credentials for you

settings.description: Run your own command that prints AWS credentials as JSON, so Claude Code can call Amazon Bedrock with credentials that don't live in your `.aws` directory.
settings.default: unset, so Claude Code uses the ambient AWS credential chain

settings.description: Restrict which kind of account people can log in with.
settings.default: unset, so people pick a login method

settings.description: Set the gateway URL the `/login` Cloud gateway screen connects to, so people reach your cloud gateway without typing its address.
settings.typeText: string, a full URL including the scheme
settings.default: unset, so the Cloud gateway screen shows an error telling people to contact their IT administrator

settings.description: From a managed source, require claude.ai account logins to belong to one Anthropic organization, given as a single UUID, or to any of several organizations, given as an array.
settings.typeText: string, one UUID, or array of strings, several UUIDs
settings.default: unset, so any organization can log in

settings.description: Run your own command to refresh Google Cloud Application Default Credentials when Claude Code finds they've expired or can't be loaded, so Google Cloud's Agent Platform requests keep working without you re-authenticating by hand.
settings.default: unset, so Claude Code's credential error tells you to run `gcloud auth application-default login` yourself

settings.description: Run your own command to generate the headers Claude Code sends with OpenTelemetry exports, for backends whose tokens rotate.
settings.typeText: string, an executable path or a shell command line
settings.default: unset, so Claude Code adds no helper-generated headers

settings.description: Choose which release channel background auto-updates and `claude update` follow.
Keep background auto-updates and `claude update` from installing any version below this one, so moving to the `"stable"` channel doesn't downgrade you from a newer `"latest"` build.
settings.typeText: string, a version number such as `"2.1.100"`; a value that isn't a valid version is ignored
settings.default: unset, so updates can install any version the channel offers

settings.description: Set how many days Claude Code keeps session transcripts and other application data before deleting them.
settings.typeText: number of days, a whole number, minimum `1`

settings.description: Set an age limit in days for the transcripts of sessions you started or most recently continued in Claude Desktop or Cowork.
settings.typeText: number of days, a whole number, minimum `0`

settings.description: Control Claude-drafted feedback: whether Claude can queue feedback drafts for you to review, and whether Claude Code shows a card when Claude queues one.
Set the probability that the session quality survey appears when a session is eligible for it.
settings.default: unset, so Claude Code uses the rate Anthropic sets remotely, or its built-in rate of `0.005` on Amazon Bedrock, Google Cloud's Agent Platform, and Microsoft Foundry, which don't receive remote configuration

settings.description: Skip the WebFetch domain safety check, which sends each requested hostname to `api.anthropic.com` before fetching.
settings.default: unset, so the check runs before the first fetch to each hostname in a session
